concept: NAT Gateway: outbound internet for private subnets
tests: Internet access for instances in a private subnet (patches) without inbound reachability.
expected: NAT Gateway in a public subnet + a 0.0.0.0/0 route from the private subnet to it. Triggers: "private subnets", "download patches", "must not be reachable from the internet".
why_not: Public subnet / public IP / IGW make instances reachable from the internet; Egress-Only IGW is IPv6 only.
